content: If the DoIP module receives a diagnostic message and SWS_DoIP_00125 does not apply but the current buffer size is not sufficient to receive the message, than the DoIP module shall send a diagnostic message negative acknowle dge message with the diagnostic message negative acknowledge code set to 0x05 as described in chapter 7.3.2.6.3 . Additionally the message shall be discarded.
